messages:
Adair Perez: hey all — I’m Adair (they/them), starting today on Eng Platform. :wave: Remote PST, will be diving into runtime infra. quick asks: who do I ping for MDM enrollment? also need VPN access for staging + prod read-only. and who’s my buddy? fun fact: used to build modular synths.

Sam Rivera: welcome Adair!! :tada: You should be auto-enrolled but if you don’t see the MDM invite check with Jordan (IT). I’ll assign a buddy in a sec — making introductions.

Jordan (IT): hey Adair — sent MDM invite at 10:05. If it doesn’t show, run the enrollment link here: https://intranet.redwood/mdm-enroll and re-open the Company Portal. For VPN, request the "staging-access" role in the access portal and add a note if you need prod-read. Also paste your ssh pubkey into the profile page so onboarding scripts can provision keys. Example: `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy`

Adair Perez: thanks Jordan — I see the invite now. Copying SSH key over shortly.

Noah Simms: hi Adair! I’m Noah — your buddy for the first month. :coffee: I’ll send a 30-min intro sync and a follow-up with resources (workstation prefs, common ARKs). Happy to pair on first PR/ops runbook.

Lena Park: welcome!! join #eng-platform and #devex — we post rollout schedules and quick tips there. If you want access to the dedicated GPU pool for local perf testing, tell me your team name and I’ll request it. Also we usually pair weekly on Thursdays for infra triage.

Marta (People Ops): hi Adair, welcome welcome :balloon: Slack sticker pack & welcome kit are en route. If you prefer a different laptop setup (macbook vs linux), tell us and we can swap. Also calendar invite for new-hire orientation sent.

Adair Perez: wow thank you all — appreciate the quick responses. Added staging request, pasted ssh key, accepted invites. Noah — Thursday pairing sounds great. Also — modular synths are the side hustle but I’m happy to bring a small patch cable kit for the next in-person meetup :synth: :smile:

Noah Simms: love that. :ok_hand: Slack DM me your Zoom handle and we’ll get the buddy chat on the calendar. Looking forward to pairing.

Jordan (IT): noted the laptop preference swap request, Marta — can you confirm the hardware req?

Marta (People Ops): yup — sent to ops-ticketing. ETA ~2 business days.

Adair Perez: perfect — thanks folks! will poke in #eng-platform with a quick hello and then start reading the runtime docs. :rocket:

Noah Simms: welcome again — see you on Thursday. :party_parrot:
